paper.title: Semiparametric estimation of the proportional rates model for recurrent events data with missing event category
paper.source: Missing Types/Papers/Semiparametric estimation of the proportional rates model for recurrent.pdf

headline_claim: provide a more robust approach using a rate proportion method for the imputation of missing event types by demonstrating that "the log-odds of the event type can be written as a semiparametric generalized linear model, facilitating a theoretically justified estimation framework"

novelty_check.key_differentiator: The specific theoretical insight that under a proportional rates model the log-odds of event type reduces to a generalized partially linear model (exploiting rate proportionality to derive a clean log-linear structure in the baseline) is a genuine and precise contribution. No prior paper in the recurrent-events missing-type literature had explicitly derived this connection or used it to build a semiparametric imputation framework within the proportional rates model class specifically.

closest_prior_work.overlap: Multiple imputation for recurrent events with missing event category, proportional rates/means model
closest_prior_work.key_difference: Uses parametric multinomial logistic model for event-type; Lin et al. make this semiparametric

closest_prior_work.overlap: Rate/mean regression for multiple-sequence recurrent data with missing event category
Semiparametric additive rates model for multivariate recurrent events with missing event categories
closest_prior_work.key_difference: Additive (not proportional) rate model; weighted estimating equations (not likelihood); does not derive the log-rate-ratio log-odds structure

closest_prior_work.overlap: GART model with IPW/projection estimation, missing event type, recurrent events, cystic fibrosis CFFPR data
closest_prior_work.key_difference: Accelerated recurrence time model (semiparametric AFT-type), not proportional rates; does not exploit rate proportionality for log-odds

closest_prior_work.overlap: IPW estimation for recurrent events data with missing category, same CFFPR application
closest_prior_work.key_difference: IPW only (no semiparametric event-type model); Lin et al. 2021b extends to semiparametric imputation

novelty_claims: Semiparametric framework for event type probability using rate proportion method to impute missing event categories (never previously explored)
Log-odds formulation expressed as a generalized partially linear model: log{p_ij(t)/p_iJ(t)} = beta_0^T X_ij(t) + g_0j(t)
Cubic B-spline approximation for baseline log-rate ratios g_0j(t) enabling simultaneous parameter estimation via approximate log-likelihood
Proof of n^{1/2} convergence rate for beta_0 estimator despite slower convergence of event type probability estimator p_ij(t)
